NextBoot compatibility runtime

This bundle includes selected unmodified upstream assets from Ventoy 1.1.16,
commit 2f66a309e4a3f0e08953aabfb0f1cf7e12b39f5d, except ventoy.cpio:
NextBoot patches its hook/ventoy-hook-lib.sh to adjust device-mapper offsets
when the data partition does not start at sector 2048.

The patch source is scripts/qemu/disk_image/ventoy_assets.py in the NextBoot
source release. Original and resulting file hashes are recorded in
nextboot-runtime.json. Upstream license notices are included under License/.

Ventoy-developed components are GPLv3+. Other bundled components retain their
respective upstream licenses. The NextBoot Cargo package license declaration
does not relicense this compatibility runtime or the modified upstream hooks.

Upstream project: https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy
Exact source: https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy/archive/2f66a309e4a3f0e08953aabfb0f1cf7e12b39f5d.tar.gz
NextBoot source and patch: https://github.com/tianrking/NextBoot

Source archives and third-party materials must accompany public release
distribution. This notice records provenance; it does not establish boot
compatibility for every operating system or firmware architecture.
